# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta18

This beta fixes Single mower History glow placement.

## Fixed

- Keep the Single mower selected-session glow/filter in screen space.
- Move the Single mower map `matrix(...)` transform to an inner geometry group instead of applying it to the same SVG group that receives the CSS `drop-shadow` animation.
- Preserve the exact same map transform used by the normal History archive, so the glow overlays the selected session instead of appearing offset.
- Multi mower behavior is unchanged; it already used the safe structure where the member map carries the transform and the glow is an untransformed child.

## Why

Single mower History uses a matrix with a negative Y scale. Combining that SVG transform and a CSS filter on the same group can cause Chromium to rasterize the glow in the wrong coordinate space. Separating the transform from the filtered group matches the already-correct Multi mower structure.
